text.formatted: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
text.plain: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

text.formatted: While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
text.plain: While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

text.formatted: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
text.plain: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

text.formatted: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
text.plain: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

text.formatted: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. _Hit:_ The creature is Restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect also ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
